answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the spiral of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The quartz is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cedar.
